title: Frozen Phoenix — Field Bundle Definitions
description: Add-on bundles that unlock specific field type groups without requiring a full tier upgrade. Each bundle is use-case justified and scoped to an organization.

bundle_model.stacking: bundles stack on top of base tier
bundle_model.cancellation: immediate field access revocation on cancellation

bundles.name: Financial Analytics
bundles.description: Unlock detailed financial fields: budget line items with GL coding, 3-way PO matching, multi-currency support, and cost center allocation.
bundles.use_case: Production companies needing budget detail and vendor payment tracking without full Pro subscription.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User navigates to budget detail view or attempts GL account assignment

bundles.name: Spatial & IoT
bundles.description: Unlock geospatial fields (GPS, GeoJSON), media metadata extraction, and IoT sensor reading storage for environmental monitoring.
bundles.use_case: Outdoor event producers needing GPS tracking, venue mapping, and weather/environmental monitoring.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User opens map view, attempts GPS coordinate entry, or views environmental readings dashboard

bundles.name: Workflow Automation
bundles.description: Unlock workflow state fields, approval chains, transition history, and automated escalation rules.
bundles.use_case: Teams needing multi-step approval workflows and automated task routing without full Pro features.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User attempts to create multi-step approval or configure automated task assignment

bundles.name: Advanced Compliance
bundles.description: Unlock compliance dashboard fields: audit findings, remediation tracking, control assessments, evidence artifacts, and compliance scoring.
bundles.use_case: Agencies preparing for SOC2 audit or managing complex regulatory requirements across jurisdictions.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User opens compliance dashboard or attempts to create audit finding
bundles.note: Basic compliance fields (certs, permits, insurance) remain CORE and are never paywalled. This bundle adds the audit/remediation management layer.

bundles.name: Advanced Configuration
bundles.description: Unlock JSONB configuration fields, array/tag fields, and settings management for customizable workflows and data structures.
bundles.use_case: Teams needing custom metadata, tagging systems, and configurable entity properties.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User attempts to add custom tags, configure JSONB settings, or use array filters

bundles.name: Custom RBAC
bundles.description: Unlock role definition management, permission grant configuration, and custom access policies beyond the standard 4-tier model.
bundles.use_case: Agencies with complex organizational structures needing department-scoped roles, project-specific permissions, or custom approval hierarchies.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User attempts to create custom role or modify permission grants in settings

bundles.name: Feature Flag Management
bundles.description: Unlock feature flag definitions, targeting rules, and per-scope overrides for controlled feature rollouts.
bundles.use_case: Teams needing gradual feature rollouts, A/B testing, or tenant-specific feature toggling.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User attempts to toggle feature availability or configure rollout percentage

bundles.name: Barcode & Inventory
bundles.description: Unlock barcode/QR identifiers, scan event tracking, kit assembly, and warehouse location management.
bundles.use_case: Production companies managing physical inventory with barcode/RFID scanning workflows.
bundles.upsell_trigger: User attempts to scan barcode, create kit, or assign warehouse location
